definitions.gloss: net assets; net worth; shareholders' equity
definitions.explanation: Total assets minus total liabilities. Used both for companies (the equity section of the balance sheet) and for individuals or funds (net worth).

examples.japanese: {純資産|じゅんしさん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}った→減る：01985_heru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{純資産|じゅんしさん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十億円|じゅうおくえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えている→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
examples.english: This company's net assets exceed one billion yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{総資産|そうしさん}→総資産：30341_soushisan⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{負債|ふさい}→負債：14950_fusai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}し{引|ひ}いた→差し引く：06701_sashihiku⟧もの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{純資産|じゅんしさん}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Net assets are what remains after subtracting liabilities from total assets.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{純|じゅん}→純〜：28361_jun⟧ (pure, net) plus ⟦{資産|しさん}→資産：15655_shisan⟧ (assets). Since the 2006 revision of Japanese accounting standards, {純資産|じゅんしさん} is the official balance-sheet heading that replaced the older ⟦{資本|しほん}→資本：03197_shihon⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {純資産|じゅんしさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧: the net assets section (of a balance sheet)
- {純資産|じゅんしさん}⟦{総額|そうがく}→総額：05472_sougaku⟧: total net assets
- {一株|ひとかぶ}⟦{当|あ}たり→当たり：01919_atari⟧{純資産|じゅんしさん}: net assets per share

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自己資本|じこしほん}→自己資本：30309_jikoshihon⟧: own capital, equity — nearly synonymous, but excludes some minority-interest items
- ⟦{総資産|そうしさん}→総資産：30341_soushisan⟧: total assets — the gross figure before liabilities are subtracted
